groups.title: Repair
groups.summary: Heating and air conditioning repair by certified technicians, with common parts on the truck.
groups.intro: Every one of our knowledgeable service technicians is certified. We have experience fixing all types of equipment, and our technicians install genuine factory authorized parts. We also carry many common replacement parts on our vehicles, which helps us get you comfortable faster.
groups.imageAlt: A clamp meter and hand tools laid out beside wiring

points: Common replacement parts carried on our vehicles

points: Experience fixing all types of equipment

services.title: Emergency Service

groups.title: Installation
groups.summary: American Standard heating and air conditioning systems, installed properly room by room.
groups.intro: As an American Standard dealer, we provide the best quality product on the market today, backed by third party ConsumerReports. Your installation contractor has a large impact on energy costs, the longevity of your system, your air quality and your comfort.
groups.imageAlt: An air conditioning unit mounted on a brick wall

services.title: Air Conditioning Installation
services.text: Our technicians install every AC system properly, so the right amount of conditioned air reaches each room in your home.
points: Installed so each room gets the conditioned air it needs
Easier to hold a comfortable temperature all year

services.title: Heating Installation
services.text: Heating systems installed to the same standard, so the house holds its temperature through the winter.
points: Heating and cooling handled by one company

services.title: American Standard Equipment
services.text: We are an American Standard dealer, and that is the equipment we put in.

groups.title: Preventive Maintenance
groups.summary: Superior Protection plans with a spring visit and a fall visit, so equipment does not fail unexpectedly.
groups.intro: The best way to prevent unexpected equipment failure and increase efficiency is to properly maintain your equipment with one of our affordable Superior Protection plans. A professional technician cleans, inspects, tests and adjusts your entire HVAC system.
groups.imageAlt: A person opening a ceiling return air grille

services.title: Superior Protection Plans
services.text: An affordable plan that keeps your equipment maintained rather than waiting for it to fail.
points: Your entire HVAC system cleaned, inspected, tested and adjusted

services.title: Spring Cooling Visit
services.text: One of our professional technicians visits during spring, before your AC is put to the test in the summer.

services.title: Fall Heating Visit
services.text: A second visit comes during fall, before you turn your furnace on.
points: Catches a problem before the first cold night

about.title: An HVAC team that treats clients like family.
text: We are an enthusiastic team of committed leaders in the HVAC industry. Our purpose is to treat our clients as family by providing proven options, world-class service, and peace of mind. We will do this with honesty, integrity, and loyalty for our company and the communities we serve.

Cowboy Cooling & Home Services was established in 2013 and works out of 13311 33rd Street in Santa Fe. We specialize in restoring your family's comfort needs one degree at a time, and we are here for you 24/7.
